summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executes obfuscated Bun payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime binary (bun-v1.3.13) from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against the bundled math_init.js via execFileSync. math_init.js is a ~727KB Bun-bundled single-line script with heavy string-array and numeric-encoding obfuscation (large encoded constant table plus a shift-rotation decoder), so its behavior is not reachable by Node-based tooling. The package advertises itself as a Slack/Teams channel data-model transformer, which does not require a second language runtime at install. The declared library main './build/index.js' is absent from the tarball, so the only functional surface on install is the preinstall dropper that runs the obfuscated payload under Bun on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
